name: Wildlife reports
description: Urban reptile and wildlife documents for East African cities: 15 long markdown Urban Displacement Risk Index assessments of individual snake and other reptile species (with headings, scores and tables, e.g. risk score, location, mitigation), a PDF survey of 2025 snake sightings and relocations in five Kenyan cities (text, table and chart), and a scanned PDF field memo dated 14 March 2025 about a snake relocation team (snakes moved to a forest reserve, injuries, the next inspection date and its approved budget). Use for questions about snakes, reptiles, species, sightings, relocations, displacement risk scores, locations, field operations, inspections and budgets.
